hbs.title: State-wise Average Inflation (CPI) - Food and Beverages

meta.coverage: State-wise Average Inflation (CPI) - Food and Beverages: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States, Table 109
meta.note: DBIE report 1653, data provider "Main". Values exactly as DBIE serves them; each series carries its unit (scripts/lib/products/states.mjs HBS_UNITS, read from the table's unit column and divisor); DBIE's unit column says: Per Cent. Periods: fiscal years, dated at April. Dimensions: none; measures: value. Jammu & Kashmir to 2018-19 (with Ladakh) and from 2019-20 (the UT) are separate series; 2019-20 straddles the change of 31 October 2019.
